title: Quasi-Trefftz spaces for the first-order time-harmonic Maxwell's equations
summary: The goal of this article is to study optimal high-order Taylor-based polynomial quasi-Trefftz spaces for first-order time-harmonic Maxwell's equations. Compared with standard polynomial spaces, the purpose of quasi-Trefftz spaces is to retain the same high-order best approximation property but more efficiently: their dimension is considerably smaller. To achieve this goal, they approximate only smooth solutions to the governing equation rather than to approximate general smooth functions.
